shortDescription: Manages device IP configuration settings for HA on a BIG-IP.

options.name: cluster_mirroring
options.description: Specifies whether mirroring occurs within the same cluster or between different clusters on a multi-bladed system. This parameter is only supported on platforms that have multiple blades, such as Viprion hardware. It is not supported on Virtual Editions (VEs).

options.name: config_sync_ip
options.description: Local IP address the system uses for ConfigSync operations.

options.name: failover_multicast
options.description: When C(true), ensures the Failover Multicast configuration is enabled and, if no further multicast configuration is provided, ensures that C(multicast_interface), C(multicast_address) and C(multicast_port) are the defaults specified in the description of each option. When C(false), ensures that Failover Multicast configuration is disabled.

options.name: mirror_primary_address
options.description: Specifies the primary IP address for the system to use to mirror connections.

options.name: mirror_secondary_address
options.description: Specifies the secondary IP address for the system to use to mirror connections.

options.name: multicast_address
options.description: IP address for the system to send multicast messages associated with failover. When C(failover_multicast) is C(true) and this option is not provided, a default of C(224.0.0.245) will be used.

options.name: multicast_interface
options.description: Interface over which the system sends multicast messages associated with failover. When C(failover_multicast) is C(true) and this option is not provided, a default of C(eth0) will be used.

options.name: multicast_port
options.description: Port for the system to send multicast messages associated with failover. When C(failover_multicast) is C(true) and this option is not provided, a default of C(62960) will be used. This value must be between 0 and 65535.

options.name: provider
options.description: A dict object containing connection details.

options.name: unicast_failover
options.description: Addresses to use for failover operations. Options C(address) and C(port) are supported with dictionary structure, where C(address) is the local IP address the system uses for failover operations. Port specifies the port the system uses for failover operations. If C(port) is not specified, the default value C(1026) will be used.
